_comment: The coordinates Google Play has told this factory are outdated, and the version each must be at or above. This file is the SINGLE source of truth for that list: `scripts/core/deps.mjs` reads it for the source-level constraint check and `scripts/lib/dependency-floors.mjs` reads it for the artifact-level check, so the two cannot drift. A coordinate is added here only from a Play notice the factory actually received, with the date and the shipped version that caused it, because an invented floor is a false positive that teaches the operator to ignore the gate. Adding a new notice means adding a row, not editing a regex.

floors.why: Play's 'outdated SDK' notice, received twice. Compose apps never use Fragment UI, so the coordinate arrives only as a transitive of Play Billing: com.android.billingclient:billing -> com.google.android.gms:play-services-basement -> androidx.fragment:fragment. Billing itself is already current and is never the thing to change; the fix is a dependency constraint that forces this transitive to the floor.
